scope: Documentation-only, no training, no new budgets, no production or scheduler changes. Proposed new criteria require approval before execution.

h38n7.rule: lost==0 and wrong==0 and unknown==0 and fresh_child_correct>fresh_parent_correct
h38n7.scope_of_wrong: non-unknown gold, non-abstaining wrong prediction, across old plus new exam
h38n7.resolution: same pre-existing decision rule, not a comparison of raw scores; exact offending item unknown without replay. Small synthetic same-author samples do not establish generalization. All three approved banks consumed; AUTONOMOUS_LOOP_STALLED_AFTER_G2 applies to H38N7 only.

beacon.causal_diagnosis: unknown. Both times UTC; early execution or metadata semantics possible; no proof replay, timezone error, or clock skew. Do not waive temporal validation or fabricate ACK.
beacon.prerequisite: Read authoritative scheduler semantics and fresh run metadata; distinguish scheduled slot from actual observation time; only if authoritative semantics permit early dispatch define separate fields under a new reviewed protocol. Verify fresh source run id and observation digest, actual observation interval, anti-replay and freshness, transfer, receiver persistence and independent receiver readback. Reject invalid, duplicate, altered or missing receipts. No training until valid end-to-end receipt and reason for original discrepancy resolved or verified semantics documented.

one_closed_loop.scope: one bounded shadow training decision then separate fresh wake consumes exact prior receipt and selects next action without executing second training cycle
one_closed_loop.policy: fixed transparent bounded decision policy, not unrestricted meta-autonomy
required_inputs: approved finite task catalog with disjoint TRAIN and EXAM hashes
one_closed_loop.admission: zero old correct answers lost; zero confident wrong and false unknown on applicable H38N7 protected exams; new exact correct count strictly increases; fresh independent exam at least 100 cases per applicable family, plus fixed old retention suite. Report coverage and abstentions; sample size not itself proof of statistical power.

decision_priority.if: receipt missing, invalid, stale, duplicate, state mismatch, pause or exhausted budget
any retained answer lost or wrong/unknown veto
decision_priority.action: ROLLBACK; propose approved remediation task targeted to failing family; do not train again in this trial

decision_priority.if: all admission gates pass and budget remains
decision_priority.action: PERSIST_SHADOW; select approved task with largest measured validation deficit, tie-break by fixed task id; propose next cycle only

decision_priority.if: no qualifying task or no positive improvement without veto
decision_priority.action: ABSTAIN_STOP or propose additional approved data for measured deficit; no automatic budget expansion

one_closed_loop.proof: event id -> source and receiver digest -> parent -> chosen task and alternative scores -> training -> independent exam -> committed shadow state or rollback -> distinct subsequent wake reading same receipt -> decision. Include counterfactual fixtures with distinct inputs leading to different decisions, replay rejection and budget exhaustion. No automatic execution of new task, no production promotion; no three-generation claim.

autodidact.scope: calibration inheritance, not H38N7 weight lineage
autodidact.primary: paired seed-level mean exact accuracy difference inherited_epistemic minus cold_epistemic, all new held-out tasks, same model/data/compute per pair; retention lexicographically prior to acquisition
autodidact.hypotheses: H0 mean paired difference <=0 vs H1 >0; proposed one-sided alpha .025 (equivalent positive lower bound of two-sided 95% paired t interval under assumptions); report paired seed effects and two-sided 95% CI, robust sensitivity at seed level. No claim if power or assumptions inadequate.
baselines: most frequent exact response computed TRAIN only with fixed tie rule; per-family only if family known at inference
previous frozen predictor, no exam-label access
predeclared simple input-only rule; report unsupported cases as abstentions
autodidact.retention: 0 loss of previously correct protected and independent old items in every admitted candidate; no aggregate accuracy compensation; no production promotion

power.pilot: two paired differences -2/124 and +8/124; sample SD about 0.0570 (highly uncertain)
power.ten_seed_normal_approx_mde: 2.8*0.057/sqrt(10) ~=0.0505, 5.05 percentage points, optimistic ignoring finite t correction
power.independent_item_approx: 1240 per arm p=.1 gives 3.37pp MDE under iid items; not valid as seed-cluster proof
power.seed_plan: target minimum 0.02 absolute accuracy improvement, 80% power, alpha .025 one-sided. Approx 64 independent paired seeds under pilot SD assumption; choose fixed sample after independent variance-only pilot and paired t power calculation, pre-register before confirmatory exam; no efficacy peeking; 10 seeds only pilot, no claim of 2pp resolving power. If budget insufficient report underpowered HOLD.
power.exam: at least 100 fresh cases per applicable family per defined cohort subject to power calculation; disjoint train/gate/test, no reuse of exposed R1.23 exam; report exact scoring, item-level paired correctness, family, seed, and data hashes.

evidence_levels: workflow logs and durable artifacts verified directly
external LLM observer read-only independent environment, not independent scientific oracle
independent examiner with blinded held-out data and immutable ground truth
